title: 馬克白 3-1~3 刺殺班柯
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder

panels.prompt: {characters}, standing alone in a torchlit palace gallery at dawn, arms crossed, staring at a distant empty throne

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 國王、考特、葛萊密斯——你都如願以償了。只怕，你得到富貴的手段不大正當。
dialogue.en: Thou hast it now: King, Cawdor, Glamis, all, as the weird women promised, and I fear thou play'dst most foully for't.

panels.prompt: a crowned king and a queen in a deep crimson gown sweeping into the gallery with courtiers, the king's smile wide and cold

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 將軍，今晚的盛宴，請你千萬出席。

panels.prompt: close two-shot in the gallery, the crowned king asking casually with glittering eyes, a braided-bearded warrior in half-armor pulling on riding gloves

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 今天下午要騎馬去嗎？要騎到很遠的地方？……弗里恩斯也跟著你去？
dialogue.en: Ride you this afternoon? Is't far you ride? … Goes Fleance with you?

panels.prompt: a braided-bearded warrior and a young boy riding out of the palace gate below, watched from a high window by a crowned figure whose reflection is fractured in the leaded glass

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（內心）
dialogue.text: 除了他，我什麼人都不怕——只有他的存在，使我惴惴不安。
dialogue.en: There is none but he whose being I do fear: and under him my genius is rebuked.

panels.prompt: a crowned king alone on his throne in a darkened hall, gripping the sceptre white-knuckled, a spectral procession of crowned children marching through the shadows of his imagination

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 她們把一頂沒有後嗣的王冠戴在我頭上，一根沒有人繼承的御杖放在我手裡。我玷汙了自己的手——只是為了班柯的後裔！
dialogue.en: Upon my head they placed a fruitless crown, and put a barren sceptre in my gripe. … For Banquo's issue have I filed my mind.

quote.text: 沒有後嗣的王冠，沒有人繼承的御杖
quote.en: A fruitless crown, a barren sceptre.

panels.prompt: two rough scarred murderers kneeling before the throne in a pool of torchlight, the crowned king leaning down toward them out of darkness

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 班柯是你們的仇人，也是我的。今晚動手——宮門外一哩之內。弗里恩斯也不能留。
dialogue.en: Banquo was your enemy. So is he mine. It must be done tonight, and something from the palace. Fleance must embrace the fate of that dark hour.

panels.prompt: a queen in a deep crimson high-collared gown standing at a dark window, her reflection pale and hollow, the crown lying heavy on the table beside her

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白夫人
dialogue.text: 費盡了一切，結果還是一無所得。目的雖然達到，卻一點不感覺滿足。
dialogue.en: Naught's had, all's spent, where our desire is got without content.

panels.prompt: a crowned king clutching his own head at a table, huge shadows of scorpions crawling across the stone wall behind him

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我的頭腦裡充滿著蠍子，親愛的妻子！你知道，班柯和他的弗里恩斯還在人間。
dialogue.en: O, full of scorpions is my mind, dear wife! Thou know'st that Banquo, and his Fleance, lives.

quote.text: 我的頭腦裡充滿著蠍子
quote.en: O, full of scorpions is my mind.

panels.prompt: three cloaked murderers crouched behind a hedge along a park road at dusk, the last streak of daylight dying in the west

dialogue.speaker: 刺客甲
dialogue.text: 西方還閃著一線白晝的餘暉。聽——馬蹄聲。目標來了。
dialogue.en: The west yet glimmers with some streaks of day. Hark! I hear horses.

panels.prompt: a torch flaring on the dark road, {characters}, walking his horse beside a young boy with a torch, cloaked shadows leaping from the hedge with drawn blades
{characters}, falling under murderers' blades on the dark road, with his last strength shoving a young boy away into the night, the dropped torch guttering on wet ground

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 陰謀！快逃，好弗里恩斯——逃，逃，逃！你也許可以替我報仇！
dialogue.en: O, treachery! Fly, good Fleance, fly, fly, fly! Thou mayst revenge.

panels.prompt: the torch extinguished in mud, a small figure vanishing into black woods, three murderers staring after him in the sudden dark

dialogue.speaker: 刺客丙
dialogue.text: 誰把火滅了？只有一個人倒下——那兒子，逃了。
dialogue.en: Who did strike out the light? There's but one down; the son is fled.

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 預言的種子，逃進了黑夜。
dialogue.en: The prophecy's seed escapes into the night.
